name: Watercolor Storybook: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Watercolor Storybook look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, watercolour picture-book illustration, soft pencil line, loose washes that bleed past the line, visible paper texture, gentle rounded shapes, pastel palette, soft daylight, white paper showing through the highlights
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colours, dark horror mood, text, watermark
